name: Zoho Client Portal App
description: Zoho Client Portal App describes a Zoho CRM external-user portal that exposes administrator-selected modules, records and fields to invited clients, vendors or partners; it is not a separate Zoho OAuth client type.
agentUseSummary: This external-user identity and CRM-sharing surface is visible as a canonical Zoho extension preview. Relay will not capture portal sessions, invite users or administer portal data beside the bounded canonical Zoho CRM reads.

capabilities.label: Use a reviewed Zoho CRM client portal
capabilities.description: If portal support is approved, extend the canonical Zoho connector with immutable organization, region, portal, user-type, module, layout, field and action-policy binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Zoho provider state
blocked.description: A Client Portal listing must not create parallel organization tokens, tools or approvals beside Relay's canonical Zoho CRM connector.

blocked.label: Capture portal-user credentials or sessions
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a client, vendor or partner to provide portal passwords, MFA factors, invitation links, cookies or access tokens.

blocked.label: Create or configure a Zoho CRM portal
blocked.description: Creating, renaming or disabling portals and configuring user groups, modules, layouts, fields, forms, licenses or invitation policies are administrator workflows outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Manage portal users or shared CRM records
blocked.description: Inviting, activating, deactivating, transferring or removing portal users and viewing or changing their shared records, notes, files or attachments are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Zoho portal actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; any approved portal feature must extend the canonical connector with exact organization, region, portal, user-type and field-policy binding.

approvalProfiles.label: Zoho client portal identity and data review
approvalProfiles.description: This external-user surface is not connectable. Portal identity, invitations, administration and shared CRM data remain unavailable until Relay has a least-privilege, non-impersonating and auditable product design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; approved portal support must extend the canonical Zoho CRM provider pack after identity and data review.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; approved portal support must extend the canonical Zoho CRM provider pack after identity and data review.

providerSetup.blocker: Zoho's registered OAuth client types are browser, server, mobile, non-browser device and self clients; a Client Portal App is not a separate OAuth client type. Zoho CRM Portals instead extend selected CRM modules and fields to external clients, vendors or partners, with invitations, user groups, record create/edit/delete authority, notes, attachments and administrator-only portal APIs. Relay's canonical connector intentionally excludes portal users, private data, writes and administration.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep using the canonical Zoho CRM connector for bounded Account and Deal reads. Any portal feature requires a separate product, privacy and identity review and must extend that connector with immutable organization, region, portal, user-type, module, layout and field binding; admin-authorized OAuth; no portal-user impersonation or credential capture; invitation and revocation audit; explicit read/write approvals; redaction; license checks; and typed tools. Do not expose raw portal administration APIs.

evidence.supports: Zoho lists browser, server, mobile, non-browser device and self OAuth clients; Client Portal App is not a registered OAuth client type.
Zoho CRM portals invite external users and configure user groups, modules, layouts, field permissions and record create, edit, delete and clone authority, with license and invitation controls.
Portal APIs require Manage Portal and Manage Portal Users permissions and the ZohoCRM.settings.clientportal scope; portal users may access records, notes and attachments.
Zoho exposes privileged APIs to activate and deactivate portal users, subject to portal permissions and user-license limits.
Zoho CRM OAuth grants remain bound to a selected organization and environment and must use the location-specific Accounts and API domains returned during authorization.
